name: @vssaros/dsh-media
description: VsSaros media library for DeepSeek Harness. **As of 2026-10-24 the authoritative store is on the dsh side**: `{dataRoot}/media-store/media.db` + content-addressed objects under `{dataRoot}/media-store/objects/<sha8[0..2]>/<sha8>.<ext>`, created and owned by this module (single writer), with a full read/write HTTP API under `/x/media/api/*` (list / stats / bytes / import / delete / restore / favorite / tags / board). The old VsSaros main-process store (`{rootDir}/media.db`, bytes at `{rootDir}/{yyyy}/{mm}/{id}.{ext}`) is still readable as a **read-only mirror** for the transition period (`lib/store.js`); the page keeps reading that mirror by default and can read the new store with `?source=dsh`.
